explanation: Old English Thunresdaeg was the day of Thunor, the thunder god known in Norse myth as Thor. Wednesday honours Woden, or Odin, and Tuesday the war god Tiw.

claims.text: Thursday is named after Thor (Old English Thunor), the Germanic thunder god.
Thursday is not named after Odin, Tiw or Loki.
Wednesday is named after Woden (Odin) and Tuesday after Tiw, a war god.
